notes.title: Retro Vision Version 1.1 Is out now!
notes.notes:
The first patch for Retro Vision is out now! This patch fixes multiple issues and also adds new content for you to feast your eyes and ears upon.

[h1]Whats New[/h1]
[list]
[*]Added brand new song "Escape".
[*]Fixes to issues with the game crashing on startup for some users.
[*]Fixes to issues with the players balance not subtracting properly when purchasing customisation options.
[*]Other general improvements.
[/list]
